title: Figma pass-through is live in Servex

owner_note.text: The cloud chat can now work in Figma with no spoken yes: call({tool:"figma", args:{...}}). It forwards Figma's own tools unchanged, and a write to a file another agent has claimed is refused unless you say to force it. If Figma ever answers 401, re-authenticate the figma MCP in Claude Code. Details are in Servex/ext/remote/doc/remote-tools.md.
